method: Decode actual near CALL displacements in target INT 2Fh handler; confirm AL comparisons and IRET after each call.
observations: All four missing externals have distinct nontrivial target entry points in BIOS_CODE.
Target entries lie after the identified hidensity routine; reconstructing the caller alone cannot provide these routines.
The 17h and 21h entry prefixes contain DOS interrupt 21h operations; their full behavior and prerequisites require further examination.
limitations: Call-target association is proven, but original source filenames and exact routine boundaries are not.
Bytes alone do not prove variable ownership, calling conventions, or the complete DOS service interactions.
